class.name: DVColorSystem
class.brief_description: Expands a [DVTheme]'s seed colours into the tokens components draw with.
class.description: Owned by a [DVTheme]; you rarely touch it directly. Each seed colour (primary, neutral, success, warning, error, info) is expanded into a ladder of steps, and semantic tokens — background, border, text, graph, accent, status and series — are resolved from those ladders with contrast taken into account, so text stays legible against whatever surface it lands on. Series colours are drawn from this system unless a chart overrides them with [method DVChart.set_series_color] or a palette is supplied through [member DVTheme.palette] with [member DVTheme.use_palette] enabled.
